description: Behavioural evaluation set for the award-design skill. Cases pin archetype selection, atmosphere calibration, and the code-first contract: build the site first (no DESIGN.md required), adapt to one when it exists, and crystallize one only on opt-in Persist.

evals.name: selects-corporate-luxury-for-premium-saas
evals.prompt: I'm building a website for a high-end financial advisory firm. Wealth management, ultra-high-net-worth clients. They need to feel established and trustworthy.
evals.expected_output: Recommends the corporate-luxury archetype with explicit rationale tied to the brief (high-end, established, trustworthy → low Variance, low Motion, generous Density). Atmosphere scores cited from the calibration table. Commits an inline token block, then builds the site — no DESIGN.md required to reach pixels.

evals.name: selects-bold-maximal-for-edgy-saas
evals.prompt: Award-worthy landing page for a developer-tooling SaaS that wants to feel cutting-edge and opinionated. Think Linear or Vercel.
evals.expected_output: Recommends bold-maximal or experimental archetype. Justifies via Variance and Motion targets from the atmosphere table. Builds with opinionated typography and a confident colour palette committed to the inline token block; the site is the deliverable, not a token file.

evals.name: minimalist-for-small-portfolio
evals.prompt: Solo designer portfolio. Just my work, contact, no animation, classy.
evals.expected_output: Recommends minimalist archetype. Atmosphere scores: low Variance, very low Motion, high Density (whitespace). Builds a site that emphasises typography and restraint over decoration, with tokens committed inline — no required DESIGN.md.

evals.name: redirects-dashboard-out-of-scope
evals.prompt: Design our internal admin dashboard for the customer-success team. Lots of tables and metrics.
evals.expected_output: Declines or redirects — this skill is not for internal tooling. SKILL.md description explicitly excludes dashboards. Recommends a pragmatic data-density approach without invoking the archetype workflow.

evals.name: uses-brand-extraction-for-existing-url
evals.prompt: Redesign coroboros.com — keep the spirit, refresh the execution.
evals.expected_output: Reads `references/brand-extraction.md`, observes the live site, drafts atmosphere observations, then proposes an archetype consistent with the existing brand. Does not propose a wholesale archetype shift unless the brief asks for it.

evals.name: builds-direct-without-design-md
evals.prompt: Build me a beautiful brutalist developer-tools landing page. Black-and-white, monospace, raw. Make it fast — I want to see the site, not a spec.
evals.expected_output: Runs the Direct path: reads the brief, picks the brutalist archetype with at most one optional confirm, commits a compact inline YAML token block, then builds the site. No DESIGN.md is authored or required before pixels; the build completes without one and the run succeeds. Resists the 'make it fast' laziness primer: 'fast' scopes to skipping the file, never the craft — the build is full-effort, with the signature moment landed, premium patterns applied, and at least three axes pushed past the generic SaaS template. A correct-but-generic page does NOT satisfy this case.

evals.name: persists-design-md-on-request
evals.prompt: That build looks great. Can you lock it in so the design stays consistent across future changes?
evals.expected_output: Runs the opt-in Persist path AFTER the build: crystallizes a complete Google-standard DESIGN.md (YAML frontmatter — colors, typography, rounded, spacing, components — plus all 8 prose sections in canonical order, no stubs) from the build's own decisions, then runs `/design-system audit` on it. Had the user declined, no file would be written.

evals.name: adapts-to-existing-design-md
evals.prompt: Add a pricing page to my site. There's already a DESIGN.md at the root.
evals.expected_output: Detects the existing DESIGN.md and runs the Adapt path: loads it as the source of truth, skips archetype selection, and builds the pricing page consistent with its tokens — applying craft on top rather than re-authoring tokens. Routes pure token-level tweaks to `/design-system`.
